title: AI in Diabetes: Temporal Institutional Collaboration Trends (1988–2025) — analysis pipeline and derived datasets
description: Reproducible analysis pipeline and derived datasets for a temporal institutional network analysis of artificial-intelligence research in diabetes, based on 16,953 PubMed-indexed publications (1988–2025). Includes the analytic cohort PMID list, the large-language-model domain classification of 67,973 unique affiliation strings, the expert-labelled validation sample, period-level institutional collaboration networks (GraphML) and network metrics, participation-tier transitions, country- and WHO-region collaboration matrices, funding-stratified metrics, and the sensitivity analyses reported in the Supplementary Information.
